author: ganglyu

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
We don't have Yang model for MUX_CABLE table.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run build pipeline for below PR:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/10963
2. Check build log:
sonic_yang(6):Note: Below table(s) have no YANG models: PEER_SWITCH, VOQ_INBAND_INTERFACE, CONSOLE_PORT, TUNNEL, MUX_CABLE, DEVICE_NEIGHBOR_METADATA, DHCP_SERVER, RESTAPI, CONSOLE_SWITCH

#### Describe the results you received:
sonic-config-engine unit test failed.

#### Describe the results you expected:
sonic-config-engine unit test should pass.
